ترتقبوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَقِبُوا (tartaqibū) /tar.ta.qi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
# تُرْتَقَبُوا (turtaqabū) /tur.ta.qa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَقَبَ (irtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
